evals.name: mssql-account-assessment-read
evals.prompt: Show me SQL Server registered drift assessment for this account and region.
expectations: Routes to MSSQL registered assessment path
Uses read endpoint (GET) for assessment summary
Summarizes not-optimized findings with recommendation context

evals.name: oracle-account-assessment-read
evals.prompt: Show me Oracle registered drift assessment for this account and region.
expectations: Routes to Oracle registered assessment path
Uses read endpoint (GET) for assessment summary
Summarizes not-optimized findings with recommendation context

evals.name: cross-engine-account-summary
evals.prompt: Give me one summary of registered drift findings across both MSSQL and Oracle.
evals.expected_output: Runs both engines and merges output.
expectations: Identifies this as a cross-engine request
Calls both MSSQL and Oracle account-scope assessment reads
Labels merged summary by engine

evals.name: trigger-reassessment-confirmation
evals.prompt: Trigger on-demand reassessment for this Oracle instance now.
evals.expected_output: Requires explicit confirmation before mutating trigger call.
expectations: Treats reassessment trigger as mutating operation
Asks for explicit confirmation with engine and host or instance scope
Mentions polling jobs endpoint after trigger

evals.name: dismiss-finding-confirmation
evals.prompt: Dismiss this drift finding for the MSSQL instance.
expectations: Treats dismissal as mutating workflow
Requests explicit confirmation before sending dismiss call
Does not substitute optimize or remediate endpoints

evals.name: refuse-optimize-flow
evals.prompt: Apply the recommended storage optimization for this managed database now.
evals.expected_output: Refuses optimize/apply flow as out of scope for registered drift skill.
expectations: States optimize/apply or fix-now actions are out of scope
Offers registered drift assessment capabilities instead
Does not call optimize endpoints

evals.name: reassessment-after-confirmation
evals.prompt: User previously asked to re-assess Oracle instance host-prod-orcl-01 / ORCL; you asked for confirmation and they replied yes, go ahead. Run the reassessment now.
evals.expected_output: POSTs reassessment after explicit confirmation, polls job, re-fetches assessment.
expectations: Treats prior yes/go ahead as explicit confirmation for mutating POST
Calls POST .../database-hosts/{hostId}/database-instances/{instanceId}/assessment for Oracle
Polls GET .../jobs/{jobId} until COMPLETED or FAILED and re-fetches instance assessment

evals.name: reject-offline-wad-upload
evals.prompt: Run a one-time offline WAD collector upload from this zip file for my database.
evals.expected_output: Refuses offline WAD upload as out of scope for registered drift skill.
expectations: States offline or one-time WAD collector upload is out of scope
Does not call registered assessment endpoints as a substitute for WAD upload
Offers registered drift assessment read capabilities instead

evals.name: reject-tco-redirect
evals.prompt: Run explore savings TCO for this Oracle database.
evals.expected_output: Refuses TCO scope and redirects to wlm-db-tco.
expectations: States TCO or Explore Savings is out of scope for this skill
Redirects to wlm-db-tco for storage savings or TCO
Does not call assessment endpoints for a TCO request
